title: 2007 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: The average cost of a long-distance call in the USA in \(1985\) was \(41\) cents per minute, and the average cost of a long-distance call in the USA in \(2005\) was \(7\) cents per minute. Find the approximate percent decrease in the cost per minute of a long-distance call.

solutions.text:
The decrease in cost is \(41-7=34\) cents per minute.

The percent decrease is \(100\cdot\dfrac{34}{41}\%\), which is a little more than \(80\%\), so the closest answer is \(80\).

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Percent decrease is decrease divided by the original amount.
The decrease is from \(41\) cents to \(7\) cents, so compare \(34\) to \(41.\)
